authority_views.enacted_statute: An exact House OLRC or GovInfo U.S. Code release point plus applicable uncodified law.
authority_views.promulgated_regulation: An official annual CFR base plus applicable official Federal Register changes.
authority_views.unofficial_current_presentation: A temporally useful eCFR/FederalRegister.gov representation that must be labelled unofficial.
authority_views.guidance_crosscheck: Non-controlling MPEP, form, fee, notice, or examination guidance used only with its version and cutoff.
authority_views.extracted_candidate: A parser or model candidate that is never authoritative without source-span admission.

invariants: Derived text never replaces or impersonates an official record.
HTTP success alone is not artifact or record verification.
Digital fixity/authentication and human printed-edition attestation are separate evidence.
Proposed, future-effective, stayed, corrected, withdrawn, and repealed events remain distinct.
FederalRegister.gov discovery and guidance sources cannot enter the verified GovInfo authority path.
Mailing-date and proposed-response-date authority views are resolved separately.
The MPEP is guidance and never outranks enacted statute or promulgated regulation.
